title: Dishing Up Murder
summary: A prominent chef is found stabbed to death in his new restaurant.
method: The killer stabbed the chef and left his body in the freezer. He then told everyone else at the restaurant about it and they helped him cover up the crime because the killer wasn't really a good person and no one liked him anyways. The victim's brother dressed up as him for the soft opening, which Humphrey picked up on because the victim is left-handed but his brother is right-handed.
motive: The killer and victim had an argument earlier about a girl. They both liked the same girl and the victim wasn't happy about the killer dating her.
killer: The chef's son, but everyone else helped him cover up the crime.
